findings.claim_text: The release names no regulator and no registration category, gives no launch date, and says customers would be KYC/AML-verified and reach the venue through futures commission merchants.
Lighter's Standard taker waits 300 ms; the opt-in Premium account waits 140 ms and pays fees.
L2BEAT rates Lighter Stage 0, with a 14-day forced-transaction deadline and upgrades that a council can make instant.
